risk: A recursive object graph can exhaust the stack during configuration merging.
reason: Prisma 7.10.0 pins @prisma/config to deepmerge-ts 7.1.5; the patched deepmerge-ts 8.x is outside Prisma's declared dependency and cannot be forced without unsupported compatibility risk.
scope: Prisma CLI and trusted build/migration configuration only; public requests do not supply objects to Prisma configuration merging.
mitigation: Pin dependencies, keep Prisma configuration static and repository-controlled, reject all other high/critical advisories, and track Prisma for a compatible fixed release.
upstreamPlan: Upgrade immediately when a stable Prisma release adopts deepmerge-ts 8.x or another patched implementation.
